summary: Evaluate parallel current density from explicit pressure/logarithmic gradients and fit coefficients

identity.relation: Sauter PoP1999 Eq12 / Redl PoP2021 Eq5
identity.definition: j_face=-F*2*pi*multiplier/(B0*dpsi_drho) * [L31*pe*dlnne+L31*pi*dlnni+(L31+L32)*pe*dlnTe+(L31+alpha*L34)*pi*dlnTi]. First axis face is exactly zero. Cells use adjacent arithmetic face midpoints with the overflow-safe finite midpoint implementation.
identity.coordinates: rho normalized radius; psi total flux Wb
identity.boundary: First current face at magnetic axis exactly zero; other gradients explicit
assumptions: Finite converted-binary64 input quantities; caller supplies consistent units and normalization

inputs.name: bootstrap_multiplier
inputs.description: Dimensionless multiplicative scale; signed algebra retained
inputs.constraints: Finite real scalar; physical source configuration uses nonnegative multiplier

inputs.name: F_face
inputs.description: Toroidal flux function R*B_toroidal on faces

inputs.name: B0
inputs.description: Reference toroidal magnetic field with signed convention retained

inputs.name: dpsi_drho_face
inputs.description: Derivative of total poloidal flux (not flux/radian) wrt normalized radius
inputs.constraints: Finite matching faces; nonzero away from axis

inputs.name: L34
inputs.description: Ion-temperature coefficient; Redl must use L31

outputs.name: j_parallel_bootstrap_face
outputs.description: Parallel current density; first entry zero at magnetic axis
outputs.constraints: Finite; equal explicit one-dimensional face shape; no broadcasting

outputs.name: j_parallel_bootstrap
outputs.constraints: Finite; equal explicit one-dimensional face shape; no broadcasting

preconditions: Declared shapes, domains and matching scientific conventions; no implicit broadcasting
supported: Evaluate parallel current density from explicit pressure/logarithmic gradients and fit coefficients
excluded: Empirical coefficients are not experimentally calibrated here. Caller must supply model-consistent collisionalities and trapped fraction; no geometry reconstruction, edge pedestal or full TORAX physics qualification.
Large finite charge/collisionality combinations may have nonrepresentable intermediate or final arithmetic and fail explicitly. Float64 conversion cannot recover prior lost precision.

Physical interpretation assumes axisymmetric tokamak geometry, nonnegative scalar thermal pressures, positive density/temperature before forming their logarithms, and compatible total-flux/field sign conventions. Signed inputs retain algebra only.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for shape/domain/finite/masked input failures; FVM nonnumeric inputs raise TypeError. No partial result.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError for nonfinite computed results; theta singular dense systems raise numpy.linalg.LinAlgError.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No iteration; theta is one linear solve. No convergence flag is fabricated.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial output returned on failure.

provenance.lineage_summary: Derived from Apache-2.0 TORAX source commit4d338d0bd3f5fd38f1a9ebb36252dcb86c33412f. Alpha and positive-Peclet arithmetic corrections retain the mathematical relation while avoiding overflow. Face-to-cell is reused from the maintained scientific library.
provenance.license_status: TORAX-derived implementation under Apache-2.0; full license and source attribution included in selected distribution.

python.signature: calculate_bootstrap_current(*, bootstrap_multiplier=1.0, F_face, B0, dpsi_drho_face, p_e_face, p_i_face, dlnne_drho_face, dlnni_drho_face, dlnte_drho_face, dlnti_drho_face, L31, L32, L34, alpha)

example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.neoclassical import calculate_bootstrap_current
one=np.ones(3); zero=np.zeros(3)
x=calculate_bootstrap_current(F_face=one,B0=2.,dpsi_drho_face=one,p_e_face=one,p_i_face=one,dlnne_drho_face=one,dlnni_drho_face=zero,dlnte_drho_face=zero,dlnti_drho_face=zero,L31=one,L32=zero,L34=one,alpha=one)
np.testing.assert_allclose(x['j_parallel_bootstrap_face'],[0,-np.pi,-np.pi])
